title: ARC Aviation Academy launches in South Dakota’s Black Hills
summary: ARC operates on a clear philosophy: helicopter flight training must prepare and mentor pilots for actual operations, not simply attaining a rating or passing a check ride.
body_markdown:
ARC Aviation Academy announced its official launch in the Black Hills of South Dakota, introducing an elevated, operations-focused professional standard for rotorcraft flight instruction.


Built to bridge the critical gap between basic Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) certification and real-world cockpit readiness, ARC operates on a clear, uncompromising philosophy: helicopter flight training must prepare and mentor pilots for actual operations, not simply attaining a rating or passing a check ride.


Across the industry, traditional flight schools often train for a rating or to meet prescribed minimums, leaving newly certificated pilots underprepared for dynamic commercial environments.


ARC Aviation Academy rejects the assembly-line model in favor of individualized mentorship, centering every flight hour on airframe mastery and operational aeronautical decision-making and risk management from day one.


The academy offers the full spectrum of FAA rotorcraft certificates and ratings—including Private Pilot, Commercial Pilot, Instrument Rating, Certified Flight Instructor (CFI), Certified Flight Instructor Instrument (CFII), and Airline Transport Pilot (ATP)—teaching every phase through a practical commercial lens.


“The helicopter industry doesn’t just need more certificated pilots; it needs capable, safety-minded aviators with a genuine command of their aircraft,” said Austyn Schlueter, chief flight instructor, ARC Aviation Academy.


“Whether a pilot comes to us to learn safe operation of a personal helicopter or to build the foundation for a professional pilot career, we provide dedicated, one-on-one instruction focused on proficiency. We don’t train pilots to pass a test — we hold them to a higher standard, and we develop them to be excellent.”


**Train at Altitude in Robinson[R44](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/robinson/r44) and R66 Aircraft**


ARC conducts primary and advanced flight instruction in a fleet of Robinson[R44](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/robinson/r44) piston and Robinson[R66 turbine](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/robinson/r66+turbine) helicopters.


By training directly in the[R44](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/robinson/r44) and gaining hands-on turbine experience in the R66, students build flight time in airframes dominating global entry-level commercial operations and private ownership.


Operating daily within the rugged terrain and high-density altitude environment of the Black Hills ensures graduates enter the workforce with superior power management, environmental awareness, and advanced aeronautical decision-making skills.


For certificated pilots and commercial operators seeking specialized mission skills, ARC Flight Academy is aligned with ARC Operations Group providing advanced airframe instruction in select Airbus and Bell helicopters, alongside dedicated specialty divisions: the ARC Alpine Academy for high-altitude mountain flying and the ARC Vertical Academy for vertical-reference longline instruction led by veteran utility pilots.


**A Direct Pathway from Licensed Pilot to Commercial Operations**


To give career-track pilots an authentic transition into the workforce, ARC Aviation Academy is paired directly with Dakota Rotors, an established commercial helicopter operator conducting a variety of missions across the Upper Midwest and Mountain West.


For those who hold the highest standard, this translates directly to employment opportunities upon graduation.


This strategic alignment provides standout graduates with opportunities for in-house career advancement, creating a structured pipeline from initial training to commercial flight operations.


Beyond Dakota Rotors, ARC’s leadership maintains deep operational ties across utility, charter, aerial firefighting, air tours, and helicopter air ambulance sectors—connecting graduates directly to a nationwide network of employers and mentors.


**Program Highlights at ARC Aviation Academy**


- **Full Spectrum of Certifications:** Individualized instruction covering Private, Commercial, Instrument, CFI, CFII, and ATP tracks.
- **Safety Management Systems:** ARC operates with a Part 5 compliant SMS, ensuring pilot candidates understand and utilize modern safety systems found in advanced operations.
- **All Robinson Fleet —[R44](https://helitrader.com/for-sale/helicopters/robinson/r44) Piston & R66 Glass Cockpit Turbine Aircraft:** Practical flight training in the industry’s premier piston and light-turbine helicopters, plus advanced transition and specialty tracks (mountain, vertical-reference longline, and Airbus/Bell airframes).
- **Proficiency, Performance, and Preparedness:** Low student-to-instructor ratios ensure progression is measured by cockpit competence and aviation decision-making rather than logbook minimums.
- **Industry-Veteran Instructors:** Students train alongside career commercial pilots bringing thousands of hours of operational experience and proven safety records.
- **Dedicated Student Housing:** Convenient local student housing options allow visiting trainees and aircraft owners to immerse themselves fully in accelerated or career-track training with zero logistical friction.
- **Tailored Private & Career Tracks:** Custom curricula built for aspiring commercial aviators as well as private owners seeking commercial-grade safety and proficiency.


**Enrollment Now Open**


ARC Aviation Academy is currently accepting applications for career-track pilots, accelerated ratings, and individualized owner-operator instruction. Prospective students, aircraft owners, and commercial partners can explore fleet details, housing options, and training pathways at[https://flyarcacademy.com](https://flyarcacademy.com/) .


*This press release was prepared and distributed by ARC Aviation Academy.*
